dict.string: Columba uses Bluetooth for peer-to-peer mesh networking and connecting to RNode radio devices.
Columba uses the local network for peer-to-peer communication with nearby Reticulum devices.
Columba shares your location with contacts you explicitly choose, so they can see where you are during an active sharing session.

Columba keeps sharing your location with the contacts you chose even when the app is in the background, so a sharing session you started doesn't silently stop. You can stop sharing at any time from the conversation or from Settings.
Columba uses the microphone for encrypted voice calls over the mesh network.
